style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the crab stays at the boulders, body twisting, spinning and claw-striking every beat, never hopping or crouching; the camera circles around him low at shell height nonstop, new angle and shot size every beat; waves, foam and the gull rush at him; the crab fills at least half the frame, except the three close-up beats
character: the crab: hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, big toothy grin, lives inside it, until 6.0 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff; ONE big seagull: white, grey wings, hooked yellow beak, mute, beak never moves with speech
props: ONE piggy bank; three flat paper sheets, each with one Russian word in big black letters: ШТРАФ, ПЕНЯ, НЕДОИМКА
environment: rocky sea edge at low tide: wet ochre boulders with deep cracks, breaking waves, wet sand

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.85 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus', o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: first word on frame one; 0.0-6.0 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 6.0 not a word, sfx go on

timeline.a: ONE big seagull dives into the lens, shut beak and eye filling the frame; below, the crab jerks aside, chattering
the gull's beak stabs the sand a claw's width from the crab; the crab scuttles sideways and wedges piggy-bank-first into a boulder crack
the gull jabs into the crack, its beak clangs off the piggy bank; the crab spins out of the crack, claw flailing
timeline.c: camera hurls itself at him over a wing

timeline.a: the crab scuttles sideways back and forth along the boulder lip, big claw snapping at the slot; the gull flaps off over him
timeline.c: circles the other way, shell height

timeline.a: the crab hooks his claw over his back and rattles the piggy bank side to side; the slot eye glares; foam rushes in the foreground
the octopus squeezes out of the slot clutching three sheets; the crab bucks and the piggy bank flies off his back, tumbling into the lens, slot filling the frame
the octopus slaps the ШТРАФ sheet flat onto the pig's ceramic flank, it sticks; the bare-tailed crab spins round
the octopus slaps the ПЕНЯ sheet flat beside it, it sticks; the crab scuttles sideways at the pig
the octopus slaps the НЕДОИМКА sheet flat below them, it sticks; the crab clutches the pig's snout
a wave pushes the piggy bank into the lens, ШТРАФ, ПЕНЯ, НЕДОИМКА filling the frame, the crab clinging to its snout; the octopus tips his cap

must_appear: gull beak fills frame 0.0, beak misses into sand 0.8, beak clangs piggy bank 2.05, piggy bank tumbles into lens 6.0, ШТРАФ 6.8, ПЕНЯ 7.6, НЕДОИМКА 8.4, pig with three sheets into lens 9.2
negative_prompt: microphone, extra octopus, slow motion, any spoken word after 6.0, accented Russian, any other text, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, duplicate props, floating objects, zoom, night, cut, scene change, top-down view, aerial view, high angle, a distant crab, a repeated or added word, extra seagull, a talking gull, the gull catching the crab, a dangling or flapping sheet, crab running into the lens
